description: This file defines a base class for media playback tests involving GStreamer elements, including setup and callback handling for video and audio elements, and various test scenarios for media tasks.

classes.name: TasksTestsBase
classes.description: A base class providing setup, expectations, and trigger methods for media playback tests involving GStreamer elements.

methods.name: TasksTestsBase
methods.description: Constructor initializing test context and GStreamer.

methods.name: ~TasksTestsBase
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up test context and GStreamer.

methods.name: expectSetupVideoElement
methods.description: Sets expectations for setting up a video element.

methods.name: expectSetupAudioElement
methods.description: Sets expectations for setting up an audio element.

methods.name: shouldSetupVideoElementOnly
methods.description: Configures expectations for setup with a non-specific video sink.

methods.name: shouldSetupVideoElementWesterossink
methods.description: Configures expectations for setup with a Westerossink video sink.

methods.name: shouldSetupVideoElementAmlhalasink
methods.description: Configures expectations for setup with an Amlhalasink video sink.

methods.name: shouldSetupVideoElementPendingGeometryNonWesterissink
methods.description: Configures expectations for setup with pending geometry and non-Westerossink sink.

methods.name: shouldSetupAudioElementOnly
methods.description: Configures expectations for setup with only an audio element.

methods.name: shouldSetVideoUnderflowCallback
methods.description: Prepares expectation for setting video underflow callback.

methods.name: triggerVideoUnderflowCallback
methods.description: Simulates triggering the video underflow callback.

methods.name: shouldSetAudioUnderflowCallback
methods.description: Prepares expectation for setting audio underflow callback.

methods.name: triggerAudioUnderflowCallback
methods.description: Simulates triggering the audio underflow callback.

methods.name: triggerSetupElement
methods.description: Executes setup element task.

methods.name: setPipelineToNull
methods.description: Sets the pipeline in context to null.

methods.name: triggerSetVideoGeometryFailure
methods.description: Executes set video geometry task expecting failure.

methods.name: shouldSetVideoGeometry
methods.description: Prepares expectation for setting video geometry.

methods.name: triggerSetVideoGeometrySuccess
methods.description: Executes set video geometry task expecting success.

methods.name: setAllSourcesAttached
methods.description: Marks all sources as attached in context.

methods.name: shouldScheduleAllSourcesAttached
methods.description: Prepares expectation for scheduling sources attached.

methods.name: triggerSetupSource
methods.description: Executes setup source task.

methods.name: shouldSetGstVolume
methods.description: Prepares expectation for setting GStreamer volume.

methods.name: triggerSetVolume
methods.description: Executes set volume task.
